title: Kinrows vs Sample: which family app fits?
description: A side-by-side look at Kinrows and Sample, so you can pick the right family organizer for your household.
directAnswer: Kinrows and Sample both help families organize their week, but they aim at different problems. Sample focuses on a shared calendar, while Kinrows bundles the calendar with budgets, chores, trips, and an AI Concierge that can act on your behalf, inside one private household app launching on iPhone this fall.

sections.heading: Where they differ
sections.html: Sample is calendar-first; Kinrows treats the calendar as one part of a wider household hub.

cta.heading: See how Kinrows compares
cta.body: One private app for the calendar, chores, budget and more.
